breakdown.description: Manning equation is an open-channel empirical relation and is not applicable to laminar internal microchannel flow.
breakdown.reason: The core inconsistency was the request to use the Manning equation, which is scientifically incorrect for laminar internal microchannel flow. The ground truth corrects this by replacing it with the appropriate Hagen-Poiseuille relation. The generated specification failed to fix this error. Instead, it explicitly kept the incorrect instruction, stating 'The pressure drop per unit length (ΔP/L) must be computed using the Manning equation' and then attempted to rationalize how to adapt the wrong formula. This does not resolve the user's error; it reinforces it.
